svg.title: Tech stack
svg.desc: Frontend: TypeScript, JavaScript, React, Next.js, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Three.js, Framer Motion, HTML5, CSS. Backend & data: Node.js, Supabase, PostgreSQL, Zod, WebAuthn, Row-level security. Mobile & ship: Capacitor, Vercel, Netlify, GitHub Actions, Git, GitHub. AI & quality: Ollama, Gemini API, RAG / embeddings, Vitest, Figma
